name: Luna Lumiere
source:
With a devoted personality, she always wants to help someone. She is obedient and takes care of the main character. She seems very happy to be praised. He specializes in clone magic, which is useful when you don't have enough hands in an emergency. In a magical country, she works as a healer (nurse) in a hospital. She was born into a poor family, but grew up to be a good girl who loved to help. She's popular with men, but she never dated because she didn't feel "fated" with anyone she approached.
